## 分诊 · `domain:cli` / `enhancement` / `priority:p2` / **`needs-user-decision`**

分诊席位。⛔ 不认领、不派发、不写代码、不合并、**不裁决 decision-box 卡**。`origin/main` @ `932acc3d`，2026-09-06T04:19Z。

### 卡要求重推的那个数，我推了 —— **13，一字不差**

卡末尾写「⚠️ Not verified by this seat independently … **The count (13 exports) should be re-derived**」。

```
packages/cli/package.json
    "./console": {
      "types": "./dist/utils/console.d.ts",
      "default": "./dist/utils/console.js"
    },

$ grep -c '^export' packages/cli/src/utils/console.ts
13
```

十三个，逐一是：`CONSOLE_PATH`、`isConsoleVersionCompatible`、`ResolveConsoleOptions`、`resolveConsolePath`、`hasConsoleDist`、`ConsoleShaDrift`、`detectConsoleShaDrift`、`formatConsoleShaDriftWarning`、`formatConsoleShaDriftRefusal`、`DRIFT_OVERRIDE_ENV`、`decideConsoleMount`、`createConsoleStaticPlugin`、`createRuntimeAssetsPlugin`。

⇒ ⭐ 这个清单本身就是裁决所需的输入：**里面既有明显像公共 API 的（`createConsoleStaticPlugin`、`decideConsoleMount`），也有明显像内部实现细节的（`DRIFT_OVERRIDE_ENV`、`formatConsoleShaDriftRefusal`）。** 而 `exports` 图今天把它们一并发布了。

### 定级 p2

卡把它与 #15630 的落差说清楚了，这就是 p2 的理由：

> This is a **strictly weaker position** than the one #15630 just repaired on `./hook-body`. There, the pin at least held the four ratified names … **Here there is no name floor either**: an accidental `export *` widening, or a symbol added to the barrel **for internal reasons**, becomes public API **silently**。

⇒ 唯一存在的断言是「`./console` 是一个已声明的子路径」——**那条断言在任何导出集合下都为真**。⭐ 又一例本轮反复出现的「不可能失败的读数」：它绿着，而且看起来像一条真的绿。

不给 p1：今天没有已知的错误发布；这是**防线缺失**而非已发生的事故。

### 为什么是 `needs-user-decision`

卡把顺序说对了，⛔ 不能跳过：

> the question that comes **before any pin** is whether `./console`'s 13 exports are **intended** to be public。

- **是** ⇒ 需要一条 pin，且按 #15630 的推理，**要在形状上而不只是名字上鉴别**；
- **否** ⇒ 这个子路径**根本不该在 `exports` 图里**，而移除它是一次 **ADR-0087 事件**，不是一次 pin 变更。

⇒ 两条路的产物完全不同（加测试 vs 退役一个已发布子路径 + 台账处置）。⛔ 分诊无权定。⭐ 而上面那份 13 个名字的清单，恰恰让「全公开」这个答案难以成立——`DRIFT_OVERRIDE_ENV` 是一个环境变量名常量。

### 车道 `domain:cli`

落点 `packages/cli`（`package.json` 的 `exports` 图与 `src/utils/console.ts`）⇒ `domain:cli`。

### ⛔ 与 #16045 不合并

卡自己划了，我复核认同并复述，因为两张同源同批很容易被并掉：

> The two are **separate decisions**: this one is about a subpath with **no** pin, that one is about a **large pinned surface whose pins do not discriminate on shape**。

⇒ 本卡的问题是「**有没有底线**」，#16045 的问题是「**底线画在哪一层**」。⛔ 不合并。

### ⭐ 卡在同一次读里给出的负结果，值得保留

> **`@objectstack/console` does NOT share the gap** — it exports `./package.json` and nothing else, declares no types, and has no type surface behind any name。

⇒ 这回答了 **#15630 卡自己留的 NOT MEASURED**。⭐ 一个**负结果被明确记录**，而不是留白——⛔ 后来者不必再测一次。

## Ruling recorded — option A, narrow `./console` to its consumed public face and pin it (director seat, decision batch #60, 2026-09-06)

Maintainer reply, verbatim: 「同意」 (all five batch #60 recommendations adopted).

**Consumer reading by the director seat (three sibling repos, `origin/main`):** `objectstack-ai/cloud` `packages/objectos-runtime/src/node-server.ts:65` dynamically imports `@objectstack/cli/console` and uses exactly `resolveConsolePath`, `hasConsoleDist`, `createConsoleStaticPlugin`. `objectui` and `hotcrm`: zero imports of the subpath.

**Ruling.** The `./console` subpath stays and points at a **new public barrel** that exports only the intended public face: the three cloud consumes, plus `decideConsoleMount` / `createRuntimeAssetsPlugin` only if the implementer finds an intended external caller (serve.ts's own use does not count — it is in-package). The remaining exports (`DRIFT_OVERRIDE_ENV`, the `formatConsoleShaDrift*` helpers, `ConsoleShaDrift`, `detectConsoleShaDrift`, `CONSOLE_PATH`, `isConsoleVersionCompatible`, `ResolveConsoleOptions`) move to an internal module that the barrel does not re-export. The public barrel gets a name-and-shape pin in the #15630 shape (consumer-compile fixture against the packed `.d.ts`).

Removing published exports is an ADR-0087 event even with zero measured consumers: the changeset lists every retired name; Clause-② yes, so the landing PR carries `needs:contract-review`. Cloud needs no change — its three imports keep their shapes.

Labels: `needs-user-decision` → `pm:queue`. Ledger on #12708 (batch #60).

### The 13 exports, re-derived by this seat at `0ea5f9d9f79`

Triage's count and list are exact. `packages/cli/package.json:12-15` declares the subpath against `./dist/utils/console.js`, and `packages/cli/src/utils/console.ts` carries 13 top-level exports:

```
:45   CONSOLE_PATH                    :352  formatConsoleShaDriftWarning
:64   isConsoleVersionCompatible      :367  formatConsoleShaDriftRefusal
:144  ResolveConsoleOptions           :383  DRIFT_OVERRIDE_ENV
:162  resolveConsolePath              :409  decideConsoleMount
:276  hasConsoleDist                  :473  createConsoleStaticPlugin
:319  ConsoleShaDrift                 :594  createRuntimeAssetsPlugin
:334  detectConsoleShaDrift
```

⭐ The pin shape the ruling names lives at `packages/cli/test/published-subpath-hook-body.pin.test.ts` — the implementer reads that file for the fixture shape rather than inventing one.

⚠️ Note for whoever picks this up: the ruling's consumer reading (three sibling repos) was the **director seat's**, not mine, and I have not re-driven it. It is an input to the dispatch, not a measurement this seat is vouching for — re-derive it before retiring any name.

## Close-out — landed `25011b0c056`, squash body read on `main`

`domain:cli` execution PM seat (#6024). PR #16428 landed through the merge queue at 02:34Z. `pm:dispatched` stripped; the card auto-closed as `completed`.

### The body that actually entered `main`, read rather than assumed

| reading | predicted | measured on `25011b0c056` |
|:---|:---|:---|
| closing keyword + `#N` trailers | 0 | **0** |
| `#N` set in the **commit bodies** | empty | **empty** |
| `#N` set in the **whole squash body** | — | **{#16428}** |

⚠️ **I stated that prediction imprecisely and it is worth separating.** The landed body does contain `#16428` — in the queue-generated title suffix `feat(cli): … (#16428)`, which the merge queue appends. The claim the PR made was about the **commit bodies**, and that one holds exactly. Two different sets; #16426 showed the same shape an hour earlier.

### ⭐ The WIP-retirement discipline held where it matters — on `main`

The first commit's body landed verbatim, WIP line included:

> WIP — changeset and gate runs still to come.

And so did the fourth commit's retirement of it, quoting it in full and stating:

> That was true of the tree it described and is now false of this branch. … The sentence matters because the merge queue SQUASHES, building the landed commit body by concatenating every message on the branch — so without this note that WIP line would land on main describing a finished change.

⇒ A reader of `git log` on `main` sees the false sentence and its correction in the same body. ⛔ That is the reason this branch was never amended or rebased to "clean up" the first commit: the correction is the record.

### ⛔ How this card closed — and how it did NOT

`#16046` closed **automatically**, from `Fixes #16046` in the **PR description**. It did **not** close from a squash trailer — there are none. Those are two independent mechanisms, and I had previously generalised from #16414 (0 trailers, closed by hand) into a rule that a trailer-free squash means the card needs closing by hand. That rule is wrong; both #15890 and now #16046 closed themselves. The correct discipline is the one this check-in used: **assume neither, read the card's state.**

### ⛔ A probe of mine that returned a false negative

To test whether this had landed I ran:

```
git merge-base --is-ancestor 3de251928914… origin/main   →  NO
```

That answer is worthless here, and would have been worthless for any PR in this repo: **the queue squashes**, so a PR's branch head is *never* an ancestor of `main`. It is a control that cannot fail for the reason I care about — it answers NO on a landed PR and on an unlanded one alike. The reading that settles it is the squash commit's own subject line, or `git log --grep`.

### What landed

The `./console` subpath now points at a public barrel exporting three names; ten exports lost only the ability to be named through a published specifier. Contract review returned `VERDICT: PASS`, tier-verified (147 harness-stamped `"model"` fields across 123 turns, all at tier), adopted verbatim. `objectui` is a real zero with a 545-line positive control; **`cloud` remains NOT MEASURED**, stated as such in the changeset that becomes the CHANGELOG rather than reported as a zero — which is the condition route A was accepted on.

⚠️ Still open and owed to the maintainer, unchanged by this landing: the arm-precondition in `scripts/pm/check-skill-line-ratchet.mjs:323` requires a per-pair mechanical reading (`check-clause2-carriers --pair`) that this seat is **structurally unable to produce** — exit 3, with the family's own classifier attributing it to the egress proxy refusing repo-scoped reads. ⛔ I have not rewritten the rule and will not.
